evidence: Carries the Utils/log/libs label and modifies disk check and file opening utilities in src/util/fs_helpers.cpp and src/flatfile.cpp.
rationale: Prevents unhandled filesystem exceptions from terminating background threads without descriptive logs when storage media encounters I/O errors. Adding logging and controlled aborts to rare disk space check exceptions provides clear value for diagnosing media failures, but addresses an edge condition that is reasonably deferrable.
